title: Differential fingerprints of eta-products
exact_target: Identify differential equations for the modular or mock-modular objects considered in the eta-product discussion.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002504 (AIM-PHYSICS-0012). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Gromov-Witten invariants and number theory, source item 1.2.

status_qualification: The source calls eta-products examples of mock modular forms; this is not generally correct. Eta-products satisfying suitable modularity conditions are ordinary modular forms. That terminology error is identified, not propagated as a definition. The source leaves the class of functions and differential equations to be clarified. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
